theses.dissent: The gate has no validated edge here, so eligibility may be noise. Industrial Metals could continue to rally if rotation into cyclicals materializes, especially given its strong momentum score and challenger status.

falsifier.text: If Industrial Metals becomes eligible (trend-gate turns true) and durable above 0.5 within 10 days.
